title.zh: 摩根大通：微软Maia300推理性能提40%，百万芯片部署降本
title.en: 摩根大通：微软Maia300推理性能提40%，百万芯片部署降本

current_state.zh: JPMorgan research reports that Microsoft's Maia 300 delivers 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems and 7x Maia 200 rack-level throughput, with over 1 million chips slated for 2027 deployment.
